# @kanaries/ml Documentation

> @kanaries/ml is a scikit-learn-style machine learning library for JavaScript and TypeScript that runs in browser and Node.js environments.

Use the Markdown links below for retrieval and reading. HTML pages are the canonical human-facing documentation. The API follows familiar `fit`, `predict`, and transformation patterns for classical machine learning.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kanaries/ml
Repository: https://github.com/Kanaries/ml
Human documentation: https://ml.kanaries.net/docs
Agent search: https://ml.kanaries.net/api/agent/search?q={query}&limit={1-20}

## Start here

- [Build JavaScript Machine Learning with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/index.html.md): Train and deploy scikit-learn-style ML models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Installation, quickstart examples, guides, and full API docs.
- [JavaScript Machine Learning APIs with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/index.html.md): Browse @kanaries/ml JavaScript and TypeScript ML APIs: clustering, linear models, trees, ensembles, SVM, decomposition, metrics, and preprocessing utilities.

## Pipeline

- [ML Pipelines in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/pipeline/index.html.md): Chain preprocessing, feature extraction, and ML estimators in JavaScript or TypeScript with Pipeline and makePipeline from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.
- [ColumnTransformer in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/pipeline/column-transformer.md): Apply different scalers, encoders, or transformers to specific feature columns in JavaScript and TypeScript with ColumnTransformer from @kanaries/ml.
- [FeatureUnion in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/pipeline/feature-union.md): Combine multiple parallel feature transformers horizontally in JavaScript and TypeScript with FeatureUnion from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js pipelines.

## Serialization

- [Model Serialization in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/serialization/index.html.md): Save and load trained @kanaries/ml models in browser or Node.js using toJSON(), loadModel(), and fromJSON() with full Pipeline and typed-state support.

## Clustering

- [Clustering in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/index.html.md): Explore clustering algorithms in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml, including K-Means, DBSCAN, HDBSCAN, Mean Shift, OPTICS, and clustering utilities.
- [K-Means in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/kmeans.md): Run K-Means clustering in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes k-means++ restarts, sample weights, inertia, serialization, and live demo.
- [E-Means Clustering in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/eMeans.md): Cluster dense vectors in browser or Node.js with TypeScript E-Means in @kanaries/ml. Covers moving-average updates, rare clusters, and measured benchmarks.
- [DBScan in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/dbscan.md): Discover arbitrary-shape density clusters and outliers in JavaScript and TypeScript with Clusters.DBSCAN (DBScan) from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.
- [HDBSCAN in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/hdbscan.md): Learn what HDBSCAN does, when to use it, and how to run HDBScan in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [Mean Shift in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/meanShift.md): Learn what Mean Shift does, when to use it, and how to run MeanShift in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [OPTICS in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/optics.md): Learn what OPTICS does, when to use it, and how to run OPTICS in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [k-means++ Initialization in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/kmeansPlusPlus.md): Initialize cluster centroids reliably with k-means++ in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml. Includes quick start code and browser/Node.js API docs.
- [Birch, Affinity & Bisecting K-Means in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/clusters/advancedClustering.md): Cluster streamed, exemplar-based, or hierarchical data in JavaScript and TypeScript with Birch, AffinityPropagation, and BisectingKMeans from @kanaries/ml.

## Mixture Models

- [Gaussian Mixture Models in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/mixture/index.html.md): Fit Gaussian Mixture and Variational Bayesian Mixture models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for soft clustering and density estimation.
- [GaussianMixture (GMM) in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/mixture/gaussian-mixture.md): Run Expectation-Maximization Gaussian Mixture Models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Supports full, diag, tied, and spherical covariances.
- [BayesianGaussianMixture in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/mixture/bayesian-gaussian-mixture.md): Fit Variational Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Models with Dirichlet Process priors in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml for automatic cluster pruning.

## Linear Models

- [Linear Models in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/index.html.md): Explore linear regression, logistic regression, regularized regression, and linear classification in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml.
- [Linear Regression in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/linearRegression.md): Fit ordinary least squares linear regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes interactive playground, sklearn comparison, and API docs.
- [Logistic Regression in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/logisticRegression.md): Learn what logistic regression does, when to use it, and how to run logistic regression in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml in the browser or Node.js.
- [Polynomial Regression in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/polynomialRegression.md): Fit smooth nonlinear curves in JavaScript and TypeScript with Linear.PolynomialRegression from @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo, degree guide, and API docs.
- [Ridge Regression in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/ridgeRegression.md): Fit L2-regularized linear regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with Linear.RidgeRegression (Ridge) from @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo and API reference.
- [Lasso Regression in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/lassoRegression.md): Fit L1-regularized sparse linear regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with Linear.LassoRegression (Lasso) from @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo and API docs.
- [ElasticNet in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/elasticNet.md): Fit L1+L2 regularized linear regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with Linear.ElasticNet from @kanaries/ml. Includes live playground and sklearn comparison.
- [RidgeClassifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/ridgeClassifier.md): Train fast L2-regularized linear classifiers in JavaScript and TypeScript with Linear.RidgeClassifier from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js apps.
- [Robust Regression in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/robustRegressors.md): Fit Huber, RANSAC, Theil-Sen, and Quantile regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml to handle outliers and predict quantile bands.
- [Bayesian Ridge and ARD Regression in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/bayesianRegressors.md): Fit BayesianRidge and sparse ARDRegression with predictive uncertainty in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo and sklearn guide.
- [Poisson, Gamma & Tweedie Regression in JS](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/linear/generalizedLinearModels.md): Model count, positive skewed, and compound targets with PoissonRegressor, GammaRegressor, and TweedieRegressor in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml.

## Discriminant Analysis

- [Discriminant Analysis in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/discriminant-analysis/index.html.md): Run Linear (LDA) and Quadratic (QDA) Discriminant Analysis in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for classification and supervised projection.
- [Linear Discriminant Analysis in JS](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/discriminant-analysis/lda.md): Run Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) classification and supervised projection in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml using SVD or eigen solvers.
- [Quadratic Discriminant Analysis in JS](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/discriminant-analysis/qda.md): Train Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA) classifiers with per-class covariances in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.

- [Decision Tree Regressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/tree/decisionTreeRegressor.md): Fit decision tree regression models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes interactive playground, split criteria, and full API reference.
- [Extra Tree Classifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/tree/extraTreeClassifier.md): Train randomized ExtraTreeClassifier models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes live tree playground, sklearn comparison, and API docs.
- [Extra Tree Regressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/tree/extraTreeRegressor.md): Fit randomized ExtraTreeRegressor models in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes live playground, quick start code, and API reference.

## Ensemble

- [Isolation Forest in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/iforest.md): Detect anomalies in JavaScript and TypeScript with IsolationForest in @kanaries/ml. Includes contamination tuning, anomaly scoring, and sklearn comparison.
- [RandomForestClassifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/randomForestClassifier.md): Train Random Forest classifiers in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes bootstrap sampling, maxFeatures, sklearn comparison, and tuning tips.
- [RandomForestRegressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/randomForestRegressor.md): Predict continuous targets with Random Forest regression in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo, sklearn comparison, and tuning.
- [BaggingClassifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/baggingClassifier.md): Reduce classification variance with bootstrap aggregating in JavaScript and TypeScript using BaggingClassifier from @kanaries/ml with default or custom models.
- [BaggingRegressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/baggingRegressor.md): Reduce regression variance with bootstrap averaging in JavaScript and TypeScript using BaggingRegressor from @kanaries/ml. Includes live regression playground.
- [ExtraTreesClassifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/extraTreesClassifier.md): Train Extremely Randomized Trees classifiers in JavaScript and TypeScript with ExtraTreesClassifier from @kanaries/ml, including predictProba and importances.
- [ExtraTreesRegressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/extraTreesRegressor.md): Train Extremely Randomized Trees for regression in JavaScript and TypeScript with ExtraTreesRegressor from @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo and importances.
- [AdaBoost Classifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/adaboostClassifier.md): Train boosted ensemble classifiers in JavaScript and TypeScript with AdaBoostClassifier in @kanaries/ml. Includes runnable browser/Node.js code and API docs.
- [AdaBoost Regressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/adaboostRegressor.md): Build boosted regression ensembles in JavaScript and TypeScript with AdaBoostRegressor in @kanaries/ml. Includes quick start examples and full API reference.
- [Gradient Boosting Classifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/gradientBoostingClassifier.md): Train gradient boosted classification trees in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes Python comparison, interactive options, and API docs.
- [Gradient Boosting Regressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/gradientBoostingRegressor.md): Fit gradient boosted regression trees in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes interactive demo, sklearn comparison, and full API reference.
- [Histogram Gradient Boosting in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/histGradientBoosting.md): Train histogram gradient boosting trees on numeric tables with missing values in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.
- [XGBoost Classifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/xgboostClassifier.md): Train XGBoost-style gradient boosted classifiers in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes runnable examples, options, and API reference.
- [XGBoost Regressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/ensemble/xgboostRegressor.md): Fit XGBoost-style gradient boosted regressors in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo, Python comparison, and full API docs.

- [Dummy Baselines in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/dummy/index.html.md): Benchmark classifiers and regressors against simple baseline strategies in JavaScript and TypeScript using DummyClassifier and DummyRegressor from @kanaries/ml.

## Covariance

- [Robust Covariance in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/covariance/index.html.md): Estimate empirical, shrinkage, sparse Graphical Lasso, and robust FAST-MCD covariance matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml.
- [MinCovDet (FAST-MCD) in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/covariance/minCovDet.md): Estimate outlier-resistant multivariate location, covariance, and Mahalanobis distances in JavaScript and TypeScript with MinCovDet from @kanaries/ml.
- [EllipticEnvelope Anomaly Detection in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/covariance/ellipticEnvelope.md): Detect multivariate outliers with robust Gaussian envelopes in JavaScript and TypeScript using Covariance.EllipticEnvelope from @kanaries/ml.
- [Covariance & Graphical Lasso in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/covariance/covarianceEstimators.md): Estimate empirical, shrunk, Ledoit-Wolf, OAS, and sparse GraphicalLasso precision matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml.

## Feature Selection

- [Feature Selection in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_selection/index.html.md): Prune noisy and redundant tabular columns in JavaScript and TypeScript using SelectFromModel, RFE, RFECV, chi2, ANOVA F, and mutual information in @kanaries/ml.
- [SelectFromModel, RFE, and RFECV in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_selection/selectors.md): Run model-based and recursive feature selection in JavaScript and TypeScript with SelectFromModel, RFE, and RFECV from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.
- [Univariate Feature Selection in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_selection/univariate.md): Rank features with chi2, ANOVA F (fClassif), and k-NN mutual information in JavaScript and TypeScript using FeatureSelection from @kanaries/ml.

## Feature Extraction

- [Text Feature Extraction in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_extraction/index.html.md): Convert raw text and dictionaries into sparse CSR count and TF-IDF matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js NLP.
- [CountVectorizer in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_extraction/countVectorizer.md): Tokenize raw text into sparse CSR bag-of-words and n-gram count matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with FeatureExtraction.CountVectorizer from @kanaries/ml.
- [TfidfTransformer in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_extraction/tfidfTransformer.md): Apply TF-IDF re-weighting and L1/L2 row normalization to dense or CSR count matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with TfidfTransformer from @kanaries/ml.
- [TfidfVectorizer in JavaScript (Browser & Node)](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_extraction/tfidfVectorizer.md): Convert raw text into normalized sparse TF-IDF CSRMatrix features in JavaScript and TypeScript with FeatureExtraction.TfidfVectorizer from @kanaries/ml.
- [Feature Hashing & Dict Vectorizer in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/feature_extraction/hashingAndDictionaries.md): Extract bounded-memory hashed features or one-hot encoded JS objects in JavaScript and TypeScript with HashingVectorizer, FeatureHasher, and DictVectorizer.

## Imputation

- [Missing-Value Imputation in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/impute/index.html.md): Handle NaN missing values in tabular JavaScript and TypeScript ML pipelines with IterativeImputer (MICE) from @kanaries/ml in browser and Node.js.
- [IterativeImputer in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/impute/iterativeImputer.md): Impute missing NaN features using multivariate round-robin regression (MICE) in JavaScript and TypeScript with Impute.IterativeImputer from @kanaries/ml.

## Neighbors

- [Nearest-Neighbor Algorithms in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/index.html.md): Explore k-nearest neighbors, radius neighbors, centroid classifiers, Ball Tree, and KD Tree in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml.
- [k-Nearest Neighbors in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/knn.md): Classify data with k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml. Includes distance metrics, sklearn comparison, and API docs.
- [KNeighborsRegressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/kneighborsRegressor.md): Predict continuous targets from nearby examples in JavaScript and TypeScript with KNeighborsRegressor from @kanaries/ml. Includes live demo and API docs.
- [RadiusNeighborsClassifier in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/radiusNeighborsClassifier.md): Classify observations using all neighbors within a fixed radius in JavaScript and TypeScript with Neighbors.RadiusNeighborsClassifier from @kanaries/ml.
- [RadiusNeighborsRegressor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/radiusNeighborsRegressor.md): Predict numeric targets from neighbors inside a fixed radius in JavaScript and TypeScript with Neighbors.RadiusNeighborsRegressor from @kanaries/ml.
- [NearestCentroid in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/nearestCentroid.md): Classify tabular data by nearest class centroid in JavaScript and TypeScript with Neighbors.NearestCentroid from @kanaries/ml for fast browser inference.
- [Ball Tree in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/ballTree.md): Learn what Ball Tree does, when to use it, and how to run BallTree in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [KD Tree in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/kdTree.md): Learn what KD Tree does, when to use it, and how to run KDTree in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [Local Outlier Factor in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/localOutlierFactor.md): Detect density-based local anomalies and novelties in JavaScript and TypeScript with Neighbors.LocalOutlierFactor from @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js.
- [NearestNeighbors Search in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/neighbors/nearestNeighbors.md): Run unsupervised k-nearest and radius neighbor queries with brute-force, KDTree, or BallTree in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml.

## Decomposition

- [Dimensionality Reduction in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/index.html.md): Explore PCA, Kernel PCA, FastICA, NMF, Incremental PCA, Sparse PCA, and Truncated SVD in JavaScript and TypeScript with @kanaries/ml.
- [PCA in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/pca.md): Learn what PCA does, when to use it, and how to run PCA in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [Sparse PCA in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/sparsePCA.md): Learn what Sparse PCA does, when to use it, and how to run SparsePCA in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [Truncated SVD in JavaScript with @kanaries/ml](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/truncatedSVD.md): Learn what Truncated SVD does, when to use it, and how to run TruncatedSVD in JavaScript or TypeScript with @kanaries/ml for browser and Node.js applications.
- [Kernel PCA in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/kernelPCA.md): Run nonlinear dimensionality reduction with RBF, polynomial, and cosine kernels in JavaScript and TypeScript using KernelPCA from @kanaries/ml.
- [FastICA in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/fastICA.md): Separate independent mixed signals and extract non-Gaussian components in JavaScript and TypeScript with Decomposition.FastICA from @kanaries/ml.
- [Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) in JS](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/nmf.md): Factor non-negative matrices into additive latent parts in JavaScript and TypeScript with Decomposition.NMF from @kanaries/ml for topics and embeddings.
- [Incremental PCA in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/incrementalPCA.md): Run streaming out-of-core PCA one batch at a time in JavaScript and TypeScript with IncrementalPCA from @kanaries/ml for memory-aware browser and Node.js apps.
- [Factor Analysis in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/factorAnalysis.md): Fit Gaussian latent factor models with per-feature noise variance and varimax rotation in JavaScript and TypeScript using FactorAnalysis from @kanaries/ml.
- [Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/decomposition/latentDirichletAllocation.md): Run probabilistic topic modeling over document-term count matrices in JavaScript and TypeScript with LatentDirichletAllocation from @kanaries/ml.

## Kernel Methods

- [Kernel Ridge, Density & Approximation in JS](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/kernel/index.html.md): Use @kanaries/ml for kernel regression, density estimation and approximate nonlinear feature maps in JavaScript or TypeScript in the browser or Node.js.
- [RBFSampler Random Fourier Features in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/kernel/rbfSampler.md): Approximate RBF kernels with random Fourier features in JavaScript and TypeScript using RBFSampler in @kanaries/ml for dense or sparse linear models.
- [Nyström Kernel Approximation in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/kernel/nystroem.md): Use @kanaries/ml to build nonlinear features from sampled landmarks with the Nyström method in JavaScript or TypeScript for browser and Node.js models.

## Gaussian Processes

- [Gaussian Processes in JavaScript and TypeScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/gaussian_process/index.html.md): Run Gaussian Process regression with uncertainty bands and Laplace GP classification in JavaScript and TypeScript using @kanaries/ml in browser and Node.js.
- [Gaussian Process Regression in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/gaussian_process/regressor.md): Fit a smooth curve and predict its uncertainty with GaussianProcessRegressor in @kanaries/ml, using the same JavaScript API in the browser and Node.js.
- [Gaussian Process Classification in JavaScript](https://ml.kanaries.net/docs/apis/gaussian_process/classifier.md): Estimate how likely each class is on small, dense datasets using a Gaussian process classifier with an RBF kernel in browser or Node.js applications.

## Cross Decomposition
